title: Publish released build on sciquiztn-knowledgebyte custom domain (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Configure the released frontend build for live deployment on the exact custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte without introducing any functional or UI changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The live deployment uses the exact domain "sciquiztn-knowledgebyte" (letters/numbers/hyphens only).
The app loads successfully from the live URL without deployment errors.
No code changes are introduced as part of the publish-only action.

file_operations.description: Add the domain verification/static configuration file required for custom domain hosting so the deployed frontend can be served on the exact domain "sciquiztn-knowledgebyte". Keep contents limited to the required domain string and avoid any functional/UI code changes.
